title.zh: 将 North Cotabato 省 Pikit 市镇 Raja Muda 描笼涯一所国立中学的附属校分离，改设为独立的 Raja Muda 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Pikit National High School- Raja Muda Annex in Barangay Raja Muda, Municipality of Pikit, Province of North Cotabato From the Pikit National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Raja Muda National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Pikit National High School- Raja Muda Annex in Barangay Raja Muda, Municipality of Pikit, Province of North Cotabato From the Pikit National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to be Known as Raja Muda National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Raja Muda của Trường Trung học Pikit Quốc gia tại Barangay Raja Muda, Đô thị Pikit, Tỉnh North Cotabato khỏi Trường Trung học Pikit Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Raja Muda Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Raja Muda ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pikit แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Raja Muda เทศบาล Pikit จังหวัด North Cotabato ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pikit แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Raja Muda แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Raja Muda, Sekolah Menengah Pikit Nasional di Barangay Raja Muda, Kotamadya Pikit, Provinsi North Cotabato dari Sekolah Menengah Pikit Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Raja Muda Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Raja Muda, Sekolah Menengah Pikit Kebangsaan di Barangay Raja Muda, Perbandaran Pikit, Wilayah North Cotabato daripada Sekolah Menengah Pikit Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Raja Muda Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. — The Pikit National High School — Raja Muda Annex in Barangay Raja Muda, Municipality of Pikit, Province of North Cotabato is hereby separated from the Pikit National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Raja Muda National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. — All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Pikit National High School -Raja Muda Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Raja Muda National High School.

Appropriations. — The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Raja Muda National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Pikit National High School — Raja Muda Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. — The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
